baseline_definitions.B0_random: deterministic seeded random ranking, matched K, seed=case_id-derived
baseline_definitions.B1_bm25: BM25(Okapi) over parent-commit candidate file text vs visible intent
baseline_definitions.B3_graph: frozen parent-only dependency graph, seed=intent-token x candidate-token hits
baseline_definitions.B4_hybrid: alpha=0.5 frozen combination of normalized BM25 + normalized graph signal

seed_rule: seed = candidate with intent-token ∩ candidate-token != empty (non-leaking); empty seed => document, no invented signal
